_comment: Direct-latent ComfyUI API-format txt2img graph: renders exactly %width%x%height%, so it needs a card that fits that latent. The default is comfyui_workflow_lowvram_upscale.json (small latent + in-graph upscale); select this one with COMFYUI_WORKFLOW=config/comfyui_workflow.example.json on a GPU with the VRAM for it. Placeholders (%prompt% %negative% %width% %height% %latent_width% %latent_height% %seed% %model%) are substituted by scripts/generation.py before submission.
